raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Some raw `amount` values carry a leading `$` (for example batch 12 onward, such as '$75.13'), while earlier rows are plain numerics, so the direct cast to DECIMAL(12,2) fails. The `$` is only a currency symbol (currency is USD for every row) and txn_id is unique, so stripping it before the cast restores the intended amounts without changing any other logic.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(trim(amount), '$', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
